Corporation.name: Cyber-Cop
Corporation.summary: Play as an Zodiac Agent investigating a series of murders around Universal Cybernetics Corporation's factory in London in this early FPS/RPG hybrid developed by Core Design.

Harry Potter.name: Harry Potter
Harry Potter.summary: Harry Potter is an unlicensed Sega Mega Drive game based on the Harry Potter movies. The game is a Pac-Man clone.

Tecmo World Cup '92.name: Tecmo World Cup
Tecmo World Cup '92.summary: Tecmo World Cup '92 is a conventional pseudo-3D soccer game.
